case_title: EAGLE ONE COURIERS VS BREEDLOVE, LYNN IND/DBA LICKETY ALL GIRL COURIER

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,275.46 FILED BY EAGLE ONE COURIERS AS TO DEFENDANT BREEDLOVE, LYNN IND/DBA LICKETY ALL GIRL COURIER ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-22-2001 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF EAGLE ONE COURIERS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BREEDLOVE, LYNN IND/DBA LICKETY ALL GIRL COURIER STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
